conviction_note: The H1 was pre-released by the 2026-08-20 revision, made with 11 days of the period left. The only new items are about 74m yen of non-operating income disclosed on 10-05, which lifts H1 ordinary loss to roughly -656m against the -730m guide and may bring a small FY revision; that is public and the stock did not react to it. Against it sits an EVO FUND warrant fixed at 20 yen, with about 13.4m shares left against a 32 yen spot, which is supply that sells into any bounce, plus a margin-long book with no shorts. The findings net to -0.3. The scaled number (p_up 47 x abs 4.0 = -0.24) agrees in sign and size. The tape moves in 1-yen ticks, about 3.1% each, so the realised move will be 0 or roughly ±3/±6%.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-05 the company disclosed 36.9m yen (Gyet, AI-reskilling subsidy booked 08-26, after the 08-20 revision) plus 37.0m yen (COEN consulting income, booked 07-31) of non-operating income that lands in H1. That puts H1 ordinary loss near -656m against the revised -730m guide if operations meet plan. A further 43.6m yen COEN subsidy lands in Q3, and the company said the FY impact was 'under review', so a small upward revision of the FY ordinary/net guide (-1,600m / -1,180m) at this print is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior non-op beat to compare. On 10-05 (15:30 release) the stock closed 33 that day and 32 on 10-06, so no visible reaction. The Q1 print (07-10, 15:30) went 56 to 55 (-1.8%) the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: it was public on 10-05 and the stock did not move. What is not public is whether it reaches a revised FY number. The company only said it was under review, and a guide revision would be printed in the same batch. If the market had priced an upward revision, the stock would have held above its 33-34 yen range after 10-05 instead of drifting to 32. The item is below operating income with no path to OP, so it is sized at a fraction of the same money as operating profit.
findings.independence: Weak support from the monthly series: Gyet's August existing-store sales (95.0%) were no worse than July's (91.9%), and COEN's weak August (84.8%) falls outside the H1 consolidation window (Mar-Jul), so operations should be near the 08-20 guide. Source: https://gyet.co.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/202609前年比速報.pdf

findings.finding: EVO FUND holds the 12th warrant, fixed at 20 yen for 30.66m shares and exercisable until 2027-04-01. Shares outstanding went from 75.85m (Q1, with 4.0m already exercised) to 89,107,638 now, so about 17.3m have been exercised and about 13.4m (15% of outstanding) remain, 38% below the 32 yen spot. That arbitrage supply continues through the window whatever the print says and sells into any bounce.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since 08-20 the stock has slid from 48 to 32 yen on 0.2-1.1m shares a day with no news. On 08-21 a +19% intraday spike on the CLANE news closed at +2% and gave back -8% the next session, which is consistent with supply meeting every bounce.
findings.why_not_priced: The level is priced: the 33% slide is visible. But this is a flow and not a stock of information. Remaining warrants exercise at 20 yen whenever spot is above it, so any positive reaction to the print meets a seller who is paid to sell. If it were fully priced, bounces would hold; the 08-21 spike retraced in a day. What money buys: on the company's own statement, operating funds while losses continue (8 years of operating losses, a 重要事象 going-concern note in Q1), so this is not growth funding.
findings.independence: Share count from kabutan (89,107,638, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=7603, 2026-10-09). Exercise schedule from the Q1 tanshin 後発事象 note (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591506.pdf).

findings.finding: The margin book is a crowded long with no shorts: 4,081,800 shares bought on margin and 0 sold as of 2026-07-17, about 8 days of current turnover. These holders are now 30%+ under water from July levels.
findings.why_not_priced: The data is almost three months old, so its current size is unknown; that is why it is sized small. A crowded margin long is the one setup in which a known-bad print still has sellers (追証 or loss-cut). With zero margin shorts there is no squeeze fuel on a good print.
findings.independence: kabutan shows 信用倍率 '－' (no margin shorts) on 2026-10-09: https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=7603

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +0.90, all from the -18% run-up, which reads as oversold. My findings lean slightly negative on supply (warrant arbitrage, margin longs), so they cut mildly against the lean. The strongest positive the release could carry is H1 ordinary better than guide on the 10-05 non-op income plus an upward FY ordinary/NP revision, landing after a 33% slide (悪材料出尽くし). I looked for it, and it is filed at +0.5.
